answer: One defence is Proof of unique national service record: a service record with discharge papers, and the haven of the whole scheme is that the check cannot be copied from one account to the next. A clone farm can generate keys forever, but it cannot generate a service record with discharge papers a hundred times without paying a hundred times over, and the wander of that asymmetry is what keeps the network honest. Running a hundred clones would mean a hundred separate proofs, each costing real money and real time, and the atlas of that bill is larger than anything one epoch pays out.
